req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of the GET /players/ endpoint, ensuring it returns all players sorted by id. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The players are returned in ascending order of their id.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert len(players) == 26
assert all(players[i]['id'] <= players[i + 1]['id'] for i in range(len(players) - 1))

tests.name: test_get_all_players_invalid_method
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_get_all_players_boundary_case
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert players[0]['id'] == '0654d83f-f48d-4ea9-847c-8a88ffc4aad6'
assert players[-1]['id'] == 'f228a3c3-2a98-43e8-b0f9-405bc4d72a83'
